comments.content: The imports `com.microsoft.playwright.ElementHandle`, `com.microsoft.playwright.options.WaitForSelectorState`, and `java.util.Random` are now unused after refactoring away from ElementHandle/typeWithHumanDelay. Please remove them to avoid unused-import warnings/build failures under strict checkstyle.

`x` and `y` passed to `window.scrollTo` and the debug marker are treated as page (document) coordinates here, but they are then passed to `page.mouse().move(x, y)` / `click(x, y)` which expect viewport coordinates. After scrolling, the mouse coordinates should be adjusted (e.g. x - scrollX, y - scrollY) or the marker should use viewport-relative positioning; otherwise the click and the red dot will target the wrong location on scrolled pages.

URL prefix auto-completion only handles http/https. Other valid schemes like `file://`, `about:`, or `data:` will be incorrectly prefixed with `https://`. Consider checking for a generic scheme (e.g. presence of `://` or a leading scheme pattern) before prepending https://.
